name: SikaGrout-9650

SIKAGROUT®-9650: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9650, October 2025, Version 04.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sikagrout-9650.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9650 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 04.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9650 is a shrinkage compensated grout which when mixed with water, produces a homogeneous, flowable and pumpable grout. Latest best binder packing models and applied cementitious nanotechnology produces a grout with superior technical performance, and exceptional rheological properties.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9650 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - For use as high strength grout in offshore foundations like monopiles using bolted connections
    - For rock socket structural grouting in offshore applications, or similar.
    - Grouting of structural and non-structural parts of offshore wind turbine installations, e.g as skirt backfill
    - Grouting under very harsh conditions, e.g. at temperatures as low as 0°C.
    Contact the Technical Department of your local
    Sika office regarding any application required not mentioned here.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9650
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Bulk supplied, high strength grout with applied nanotechnology for grouting offshore wind turbine installations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Certified by Det Norske Veritas (DNV)
    - DNV Type Approval Certificate No: TAK0000202
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 12390-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - EN 206: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 12390-13: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM C469: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Available as silo material.
    - Can be applied in the shortest weather windows.
    - Excellent strength gain.
    - No segregation or bleeding to ensure consistent final physical performance.
    - For applications in a wide temperature range.
    - Excellent flow and pumping properties reduce installation times and costs.
    - Very fast grout installation: limited to no interfer-ence with the critical path of the installation vessel.
    - Pumpable through 2” grout lines.
    - Volume stable.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: Approximately 2.25 gr/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Bleeding: No bleeding; Sedimentation stability: No sedimentation; (in accordance of DAfStb Self compacting concrete, section N.1.2.)
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | N/mm² | 5 oC | 10 oC | 20 oC |
    | 8 hours | ≥ 5 |
    | 12 hours | ≥ 5 | ≥ 30 |
    | 1 day | ≥ 30 | ≥ 40 | ≥ 65 |
    | 7 days | ≥ 70 | ≥ 75 |
    | 28 days | ≥ 75 | ≥ 80 | ≥ 90 |
    | Results of 150 mm cubes |
    | Characteristic compressive strength: |
    | Age | 20 oC | -1 oC |
    | 28 days | ≥ 80 N/mm² | ≥ 80 N/mm² |
    | Results of 150 x 300 mm cylinders |
    | Exposure classes: |
    | XO, XC4, XD3, XS2, XS3, XF3, XA2, WA |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 12390-3)

2.8 Modulus of elasticity in compression.

    | Poisson´s ratio: |

    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

2.10 Shrinkage. Restrained shrinkage:
    | Age | mm/m |

    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9650 is supplied by bulk transport and is stored in special jobsite silos or containers. Upon request, the material may be available as well in special 1000 kg big bags.
    - Shelf life: 6 months from date of production. First-in / First-out principle shall however be used.
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in closed silos or warehouse under dry conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 04.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 04.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 140 (± 5) litres / 1000 kg powder
    - Consumption: 1000 kg powder will yield approximately 485 to 530 litre of mixed grout.
    - Layer thickness: 50 - 1000 mm
4.3 Pot Life.
    | 20°C | 10°C |
    | ≥ 180 minutes | ≥ 240 minutes |
4.4 Notes on installation.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
    - SikaGrout®-9650 which will be exposed to strong drying conditions, e.g. mortar which is directly exposed to heavy wind and/or direct sunlight, should be protected using appropriate curing agents.
    - As the powder may densify over time, especially when the goods are stored on the vessel in the offshore silos and exposed to many vibrations, the First-in / First-out principle is key to a successful grouting job.
4.5 Equipment.
    | Mixer and pump type | Continuous mixing and pumping system |
    | Minimum diameter of grout lines | ≥ 2 inch |
    | Grout annulus | 50 ≤ t ≤ 1000 |
    | Pumping length through 2” flexible hose | L ≤ 225 m |
    | Pumping elevated head with 2” flexible hose | H ≤ 25 m |
    Batch mixing system Operating limitations:
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9650 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.
4.7 Further documentation. Sika Method Statement: SikaGrout®-9650

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: N/mm² | 5 oC | 10 oC | 20 oC; 8 hours | ≥ 5; 12 hours | ≥ 5 | ≥ 30; 1 day | ≥ 30 | ≥ 40 | ≥ 65; 7 days | ≥ 70 | ≥ 75; 28 days | ≥ 75 | ≥ 80 | ≥ 90; Results of 150 mm cubes; Characteristic compressive strength:; Age | 20 oC | -1 oC; 28 days | ≥ 80 N/mm² | ≥ 80 N/mm²; Results of 150 x 300 mm cylinders; Exposure classes:; XO, XC4, XD3, XS2, XS3, XF3, XA2, WA (EN 12390-3) (EN 206)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: Age | GPa; 28 days | 35.6; Poisson´s ratio:; 0.19 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: Age | 20 oC | -1 oC; 28 days | ≥ 15 N/mm² | ≥ 14 N/mm²; Results of 40 x 40 x 160 mm prisms (EN 12390-3)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9650, October 2025, Version 04.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sikagrout-9650.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrout®-9650, version 08/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/SDS%20SikaGrout%20-%209650%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
